output_list.criticism: The balanceOf function does not check if the address has been created before. If the address has not been created, the function will return the free amount. This can be exploited by the attacker to get more tokens than he should have. The attacker can create an address, transfer tokens to it and then call the balanceOf function to get more tokens than he should have.
